product_summary: Official website (sundram.com) product menu lists: High Tensile Fasteners, Cold Extrusion, Hot Forged parts, Powertrain Components, Pumps & Assemblies, Radiator Caps, Powder Metallurgy, Iron Powder. Core business is automotive OEM fasteners and engine/drivetrain components, not construction/DIY hardware. Declared codes 731815 (bolts/screws) and 731816 (nuts) match the fastener line exactly; 870899 matches the automotive powertrain/radiator-cap line. Not declared but present on the site: pumps & assemblies (8413), hot forged/cold extruded steel parts (7326), powder metallurgy parts, and iron powder (7205) - a separate metallurgical product line. Washers (731822) are typical of a high-tensile fastener range but not individually confirmed on the pages I could open (product sub-pages returned 404).
comment: HS mapping: partial. 731815 and 731816 are exact matches to the declared fastener lines; 870899 is a plausible partial match for powertrain/radiator-cap automotive parts. Industry classification 'Строительство и DIY' (construction & DIY) is a misclassification: the company is an automotive OEM tier-1 component manufacturer (fasteners, powertrain, pumps, powder metallurgy), not a construction/DIY supplier. Product lines missing from the declaration: pumps & assemblies (HS 8413), hot forged and cold extruded steel parts (HS 7326), powder metallurgy components, and iron powder (HS 7205). No trader signs - own manufacturing plants and digital product catalogues per line. Per project rule 3, the HS mismatch is not a rejection ground: company is retained, code set corrected to the actual product mix. All product lines above are 'заявлено, не подтверждено' - sourced from the company's own website product menu (https://www.sundram.com/), not from a customs line; no shipment-level HS records were checked in this task. Note: web_search backend was unavailable (connection refused) and product sub-pages returned HTTP 404, so only the homepage product menu could be read; washer code 731822 and gear codes 8483 are inferred from the product category, not individually confirmed.
